encounter.text: At the edge of the Abyss, something waits that is not quite a creature and not quite a shadow. It speaks without a mouth. 'You closed the outer doors. Industrious. But the hinge was only ever a lock on this side.' A pause that feels like cold water. 'I have been here longer than the tunnels. I was here when the first rat dug the first passage. I am what they were digging toward.'

wants.text: 'What everything wants. To continue. The world above is warm and full of small moving things. I have been patient.' The darkness shifts. 'You have been persistent. I can respect persistence. Step aside.'

refuse.text: The shade regards you for a long moment. Then: 'All right.' The darkness collapses inward. Everything goes cold and loud at once. And then — you fight.
